Nil recordable injuries
Roll out the upgrade of the HSE Incident/Observations process
Deliver a step change in IMS & Process Safety compliance
100% of customer nominations delivered within the contractual delivery tolerance of ±4% (or, if outside that tolerance, without any contractual refunds payable to customers)
Deliver a step change in maintenance delivery (including SIB)
Data driven insights – Implement the next phase of the Data Utilisation Project and roll out the dashboards in line or ahead of the project plan
Spend Smarter – Deliver a target of $250k of recurring O&M savings in addition to the budget targets
Digital & Cyber – Complete Horizon 1 activities (incl. MSP implementation; Project Flowbridge and address all FY26 AESCSF internal audit findings, with a Board-approved plan to reach SP2
Project delivered on or under revised P50 budget forecast ($112.4M)
Project is handed over and RFSU in January 2027
Phase 1 & 2 of FEL2 in line with budget and schedule agreed post EAA
Technology selection complete and order ready to be paced for turbines
Regulatory approvals on track in line with schedule and Approvals Plan as at the FEL2 gate
The negotiation and finalisation of the AFO and LLI/Project Financing requirements
Project assurance plan endorsed by the Board
Approved progression through the end of FEL2 gate by the end of financial year by all key project stakeholders

Develop a commercial market model and customer re-contracting strategy, responding to changing market dynamics, (eg SWP expansion and domestic gas reservation), that support material progress on further Pillar 1 expansion opportunities, post 2030. Execute on Board agreed components of the strategy in FY27
Develop a growth seriatim of opportunities, with a focus on Pillar 1 & 4, that Lochard has a competitive advantage to deliver with (1) commercial viability and (2) potential for FID within 3-4 years
On budget, as per FY27 budget endorsed by Board
Model endorsed by Board June '26 as starting point. Model endorsed by Board at end FY27 as end point
